task: Fix CodeMie CLI so per-profile CodeMie URL and related identity fields (codeMieProject/codeMieIntegration) are stored and updated independently per profile instead of sharing one workspace-level value across all profiles in a storage scope.

key_reasoning.reason: Touches 3-4 components across 2-3 layers: the CLI setup wizard's 'Update existing profile' branch and profile display (src/cli/commands/setup.ts, src/cli/commands/profile/index.ts), the config-persistence chokepoint (ConfigLoader.saveProfile/initProjectConfig/splitProfileAndWorkspace/resolveWorkspace in src/utils/config.ts), and the migration layer (a new migration likely needed alongside 007). Compared against the project L-band example profile-provider-decoupling.json (component_scope XL/5, 6 areas including the Claude agent plugin's statusline.mjs and assistants-CLI historyLoader/selection paths), this fix's surface is narrower — the technical-analysis identifies no equivalent agent-plugin or assistants-CLI touch points — so it stays at L rather than XL.

No exact precedent for re-scoping already-shared identity fields (codeMieUrl/codeMieProject/codeMieIntegration) back to per-profile storage without breaking the documented local/global 'team project context' overlay behavior; a currently-passing test explicitly asserts today's shared-workspace behavior as correct and must be flipped. Baseline M, bumped to L by the 'requires data migration' red flag: existing users' persisted global/local config files likely need migrating, mirroring the same Migration/MigrationRegistry pattern the profile-provider-decoupling.json example used (which received the identical M-to-L bump for the identical reason).

~7 files: modified src/utils/config.ts, src/env/types.ts, src/cli/commands/profile/index.ts, and the existing config-project-override.test.ts (which currently codifies the reported bug and must be updated); new migration file + migration test, and likely a new regression test for the setup wizard's 'Update existing profile' flow (the coverage gap explicitly named in the research, required by AC4). Baseline M, bumped to L by the same data-migration red flag. Substantially smaller than the reference example's XXL(6)/14-files-across-6-dirs, which additionally touched assistants-CLI and agent-plugin files not implicated here.

3 layers touched: CLI/Workflow (setup wizard update flow + profile display), Service (ConfigLoader resolution/split logic), and DB-Persistence (config file writes plus a likely migration) — matches the L criteria (3-4 layers including persistence, schema change or migration) and the reference example's identical L(4) rating for the same subsystem.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from M (3) to L (4): requires a data migration to move existing users' persisted codeMieUrl/codeMieProject/codeMieIntegration values from shared workspace storage into per-profile storage.
File Change Estimate bumped from M (3) to L (4): the same data-migration red flag adds a new migration file and its test to the change surface.
